view.scene_description: A modern, well-lit interior space resembling a library or co-working area. Wooden arches and shelves contrast with blue-tinted glass walls and glowing vertical light strips. People sit at tables or workstations, surrounded by potted plants and book displays. The polished floor reflects overhead lights and structural elements.

objects.label: person sitting at desk
objects.observation: A person in a dark jacket sits at a wooden desk on the left, facing away from the camera. Their head is slightly turned, and they appear to be working on a laptop. The desk has a curved wooden edge and is partially obscured by the person's body.

objects.label: wooden arched shelving
objects.observation: Curved wooden shelves with an arched design run along the left wall. They hold books and have recessed lighting above them. The wood grain is visible, and the arches create a warm, inviting aesthetic against the cool-toned background.

objects.label: blue glass wall with vertical lights
objects.observation: A large glass wall dominates the center-right of the frame, tinted blue. Vertical light strips emit a bright glow, creating a futuristic ambiance. Reflections of interior lights and structures are visible on its surface.

objects.label: person sitting at table
objects.observation: A person wearing a checkered shirt sits at a white round table near the center-right. They are seated on a metal chair and appear to be looking down, possibly at a device. A small plant and a sign stand nearby.

objects.label: potted plant
objects.observation: A tall green leafy plant in a white cylindrical pot stands near the blue glass wall. It adds a natural element to the modern setting and is positioned between the glass wall and a freestanding sign.

objects.label: circular bookshelf
objects.observation: A circular, multi-tiered shelf made of light-colored wood is located on the right side. It holds books and decorative items. The shelf has a perforated pattern on its inner surface and is illuminated by a ring light.

objects.label: white round table
objects.observation: A white round table with a thin metal base is situated near the blue glass wall. It is occupied by a person and has a small cup or container on it. The table’s reflective surface mirrors the surrounding environment.

objects.label: metal chair
objects.observation: A simple metal chair with a flat seat and backrest is placed under the white round table. Its legs are thin and cylindrical, and it appears to be designed for casual seating in a public space.

objects.label: ceiling lights
objects.observation: The ceiling features recessed circular lights that emit a soft glow. Some lights are directly embedded in the ceiling, while others are mounted on a metallic grid structure. The ceiling also has a reflective surface that enhances brightness.

objects.label: book display
objects.observation: Books are arranged on the circular shelf on the right and on the wooden shelves on the left. Some titles are visible, including one with Chinese characters. The books are upright and neatly organized.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000028", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
